question: How many website sessions are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(website_session_id) AS total_sessions FROM toystore.website_sessions

question: What are the total number of orders and total gross revenue across all time?
sql: SELECT count(order_id) AS total_orders, sum(price_usd) AS total_gross_revenue FROM toystore.orders

question: List each product with its launch date, oldest first.
sql: SELECT product_name, created_at AS launch_date FROM toystore.products ORDER BY created_at ASC, product_id ASC

question: How many sessions came from each device type?
sql: SELECT device_type, COUNT(DISTINCT website_session_id) AS sessions FROM toystore.website_sessions GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY sessions DESC

question: What is the all-time average order value?
sql: SELECT SUM(price_usd) / COUNT(order_id) AS average_order_value FROM toystore.orders

question: What is the all-time gross margin percentage?
sql: SELECT SUM(price_usd - cogs_usd) / SUM(price_usd) AS gross_margin_percentage FROM toystore.orders

question: Show monthly sessions, orders and session-to-order conversion rate.
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', s.created_at)::date AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT s.website_session_id) AS sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT s.website_session_id) AS session_to_order_cvr FROM toystore.website_sessions s LEFT JOIN toystore.orders o ON s.website_session_id = o.website_session_id WHERE s.created_at >= '2012-04-01' AND s.created_at < '2015-03-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Show revenue per session for each month.
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', s.created_at)::date AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT s.website_session_id) AS total_sessions, SUM(o.price_usd) AS gross_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(o.price_usd), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.website_session_id) AS revenue_per_session FROM toystore.website_sessions s LEFT JOIN toystore.orders o ON s.website_session_id = o.website_session_id WHERE s.created_at >= '2012-04-01' AND s.created_at < '2015-03-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.created_at) ORDER BY month

question: What was gross revenue in 2013 and in 2014?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) AS year, SUM(price_usd) AS gross_revenue FROM toystore.orders WHERE created_at >= '2013-01-01' AND created_at < '2015-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: What is the session-to-order conversion rate for each device type across all time?
sql: SELECT ws.device_type AS device_type, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.website_session_id) AS total_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ws.website_session_id), 0) AS conversion_rate FROM toystore.website_sessions ws LEFT JOIN toystore.orders o ON ws.website_session_id = o.website_session_id GROUP BY ws.device_type ORDER BY total_sessions DESC

question: For each marketing channel, show sessions, orders and conversion rate across all time.
sql:
SELECT 
  CASE
    WHEN ws.utm_source IS NULL AND ws.http_referer IS NULL THEN 'direct'
    WHEN ws.utm_source IS NULL THEN 'organic_search'
    WHEN ws.utm_source = 'socialbook' THEN 'paid_social'
    WHEN ws.utm_campaign = 'brand' THEN 'paid_brand'
    WHEN ws.utm_campaign = 'nonbrand' THEN 'paid_nonbrand'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS marketing_channel,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ws.website_session_id) AS sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ws.website_session_id), 0) AS session_to_order_cvr
FROM toystore.website_sessions ws
LEFT JOIN toystore.orders o ON ws.website_session_id = o.website_session_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY sessions DESC

question: What share of all sessions comes from paid non-brand traffic?
sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN utm_campaign = 'nonbrand' AND utm_source IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS paid_nonbrand_share FROM toystore.website_sessions

question: For paid non-brand traffic only, compare revenue per session on mobile and desktop.
sql: SELECT ws.device_type, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.website_session_id) AS sessions, COALESCE(SUM(o.price_usd), 0.00) AS gross_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(o.price_usd), 0.00) / COUNT(DISTINCT ws.website_session_id) AS revenue_per_session FROM toystore.website_sessions ws LEFT JOIN toystore.orders o ON ws.website_session_id = o.website_session_id WHERE CASE WHEN ws.utm_source IS NULL AND ws.http_referer IS NULL THEN 'direct' WHEN ws.utm_source IS NULL THEN 'organic_search' WHEN ws.utm_source = 'socialbook' THEN 'paid_social' WHEN ws.utm_campaign = 'brand' THEN 'paid_brand' WHEN ws.utm_campaign = 'nonbrand' THEN 'paid_nonbrand' ELSE 'other' END = 'paid_nonbrand' AND ws.device_type IN ('mobile', 'desktop') GROUP BY ws.device_type

question: Show sessions by channel for each quarter.
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', ws.created_at)::DATE AS quarter_start, CASE WHEN ws.utm_source IS NULL AND ws.http_referer IS NULL THEN 'direct' WHEN ws.utm_source IS NULL THEN 'organic_search' WHEN ws.utm_source = 'socialbook' THEN 'paid_social' WHEN ws.utm_campaign = 'brand' THEN 'paid_brand' WHEN ws.utm_campaign = 'nonbrand' THEN 'paid_nonbrand' ELSE 'other' END AS channel, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.website_session_id) AS sessions FROM toystore.website_sessions ws WHERE ws.created_at >= '2012-04-01' AND ws.created_at < '2015-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

question: For each device type, how many sessions reached the cart, shipping, billing and order confirmation pages?
sql: SELECT ws.device_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.pageview_url = '/cart' THEN ws.website_session_id END) AS cart_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.pageview_url = '/shipping' THEN ws.website_session_id END) AS shipping_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.pageview_url IN ('/billing', '/billing-2') THEN ws.website_session_id END) AS billing_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.pageview_url = '/thank-you-for-your-order' THEN ws.website_session_id END) AS order_confirmation_sessions FROM toystore.website_sessions ws JOIN toystore.website_pageviews wp ON ws.website_session_id = wp.website_session_id GROUP BY ws.device_type

question: What is the overall bounce rate?
sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN pageview_counts.pageview_count = 1 THEN 1 END)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS overall_bounce_rate FROM (SELECT s.website_session_id, COUNT(p.website_pageview_id) AS pageview_count FROM toystore.website_sessions s LEFT JOIN toystore.website_pageviews p ON s.website_session_id = p.website_session_id GROUP BY s.website_session_id) pageview_counts

question: Show sessions and bounce rate for each landing page.
sql:
WITH session_landing_pages AS (
  SELECT
    ws.website_session_id,
    wp.pageview_url AS landing_page
  FROM toystore.website_sessions ws
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      website_session_id,
      website_pageview_id,
      pageview_url,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY website_session_id ORDER BY website_pageview_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM toystore.website_pageviews
  ) wp ON ws.website_session_id = wp.website_session_id AND wp.rn = 1
),
session_pageview_counts AS (
  SELECT
    website_session_id,
    COUNT(*) AS pageview_count
  FROM toystore.website_pageviews
  GROUP BY website_session_id
)
SELECT
  slp.landing_page,
  COUNT(DISTINCT slp.website_session_id) AS sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN spc.pageview_count = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT slp.website_session_id) AS bounce_rate
FROM session_landing_pages slp
JOIN session_pageview_counts spc ON slp.website_session_id = spc.website_session_id
GROUP BY slp.landing_page
ORDER BY sessions DESC

question: Compare the order conversion rate of /billing and /billing-2 during the period when both pages were live.
sql:
WITH billing_test_dates AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(created_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(created_at) AS end_at
  FROM toystore.website_pageviews
  WHERE pageview_url = '/billing-2'
),
session_billing_pages AS (
  SELECT
    pv.website_session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pv.pageview_url = '/billing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS viewed_billing,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pv.pageview_url = '/billing-2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS viewed_billing_2
  FROM toystore.website_pageviews pv
  JOIN billing_test_dates d
    ON pv.created_at >= d.start_at AND pv.created_at <= d.end_at
  WHERE pv.pageview_url IN ('/billing', '/billing-2')
  GROUP BY pv.website_session_id
),
session_page_type AS (
  SELECT
    website_session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN viewed_billing_2 = 1 AND viewed_billing = 0 THEN '/billing-2'
      WHEN viewed_billing = 1 AND viewed_billing_2 = 0 THEN '/billing'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS billing_page_version
  FROM session_billing_pages
),
session_orders AS (
  SELECT
    website_session_id,
    COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
  FROM toystore.orders
  GROUP BY website_session_id
)
SELECT
  pt.billing_page_version,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pt.website_session_id) AS sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT pt.website_session_id), 0) AS conversion_rate
FROM session_page_type pt
LEFT JOIN toystore.orders o
  ON pt.website_session_id = o.website_session_id
WHERE pt.billing_page_version IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pt.billing_page_version
detail: Needs the overlap window. Comparing all time would be unfair.

question: For each month since the first cross-sell item was sold, what percentage of orders had more than one item?
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.created_at)::DATE AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.items_purchased > 1 THEN o.order_id END) AS multi_item_orders, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.items_purchased > 1 THEN o.order_id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) * 100, 2) AS percentage_multi_item FROM toystore.orders o JOIN toystore.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.is_primary_item = 0 AND o.created_at >= (SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM toystore.order_items WHERE is_primary_item = 0) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.created_at) ORDER BY month
detail: The start date must come from the data, and the last month is partial.

question: Which primary product and cross-sell product pairs are bought together most often? Show all pairs with their order counts.
sql: SELECT p_primary.product_name AS primary_product_name, p_cross.product_name AS cross_sell_product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM toystore.orders o JOIN toystore.order_items oi_cross ON o.order_id = oi_cross.order_id AND oi_cross.is_primary_item = 0 JOIN toystore.products p_primary ON o.primary_product_id = p_primary.product_id JOIN toystore.products p_cross ON oi_cross.product_id = p_cross.product_id GROUP BY p_primary.product_name, p_cross.product_name ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: What is the all-time revenue of each product?
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price_usd), 0.00) AS all_time_revenue FROM toystore.products p LEFT JOIN toystore.order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY all_time_revenue DESC

question: What is the refund rate of each product?
sql: SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(oir.order_item_refund_id)::DECIMAL / COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS refund_rate FROM toystore.products p JOIN toystore.order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN toystore.order_item_refunds oir ON oi.order_item_id = oir.order_item_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY refund_rate DESC

question: What is all-time net revenue?
sql: SELECT SUM(o.price_usd) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue FROM toystore.orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_usd) AS refund_amount_usd FROM toystore.order_item_refunds GROUP BY order_id) r ON o.order_id = r.order_id

question: What was net revenue for each year in which the orders were placed?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) AS order_year, SUM(o.price_usd) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue FROM toystore.orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_usd) AS refund_amount_usd FROM toystore.order_item_refunds GROUP BY order_id) r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) ORDER BY order_year

question: Compare the conversion rate of new and repeat sessions across all time.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN s.is_repeat_session = 1 THEN 'repeat' ELSE 'new' END AS session_type, COUNT(DISTINCT s.website_session_id) AS total_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT s.website_session_id) AS conversion_rate FROM toystore.website_sessions s LEFT JOIN toystore.orders o ON s.website_session_id = o.website_session_id GROUP BY s.is_repeat_session
detail: New vs repeat comes from is_repeat_session.

question: What percentage of customers placed more than one order?
sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders FROM toystore.orders GROUP BY user_id) SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN total_orders > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUMERIC) / COUNT(*) AS pct_customers_multiple_orders FROM customer_orders

question: Of the visitors whose first session was between April 2012 and December 2014, what percentage came back within 30 days?
sql:
WITH user_first_session AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MIN(created_at) AS first_session_at
  FROM toystore.website_sessions
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MIN(created_at) >= '2012-04-01' AND MIN(created_at) < '2015-01-01'
),
subsequent_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    f.user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.created_at > f.first_session_at AND s.created_at <= f.first_session_at + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS came_back_within_30_days
  FROM user_first_session f
  JOIN toystore.website_sessions s ON f.user_id = s.user_id
  GROUP BY f.user_id
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_first_time_visitors,
  SUM(came_back_within_30_days) AS visitors_who_came_back,
  CAST(SUM(came_back_within_30_days) AS NUMERIC) / COUNT(*) AS repeat_visitor_percentage
FROM subsequent_sessions
